🛑 HMPV, or Human Metapneumovirus, is a virus that belongs to the Paramyxoviridae family. 

⭕ This virus is a common cause of respiratory infections, especially in children and the elderly. https://t.co/1jK1RF6QEv

🛑 HMPV, or Human Metapneumovirus, is a virus that belongs to the Paramyxoviridae family. 

⭕ This virus is a common cause of respiratory infections, especially in children and the elderly. https://t.co/1jK1RF6QEv

nodes.author: Leo73723791
nodes.text: ⭕ Symptoms: Infection with this virus includes symptoms such as cough, fever, nasal congestion, difficulty breathing, and sometimes bronchitis or pneumonia. In severe cases, it can lead to bronchitis or pneumonia.

nodes.author: Leo73723791
nodes.text: ⭕ Transmission: The virus is transmitted from person to person through droplets resulting from sneezing or coughing, or through direct contact with body fluids such as the nose or sputum.

nodes.author: Leo73723791
nodes.text: ⭕ Diagnosis: Diagnosis is usually made by examining symptoms and taking into account medical history, but laboratory testing may be necessary to confirm the virus, especially in severe cases or in at-risk groups.
